title: Teodoro denies Asean members opposed PH handling of China invite

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday denied China’s claim that several Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) countries had opposed the Philippines’ handling of Beijing’s participation in last week’s regional defense meetings in Cebu. Teodoro said no Asean member state had raised concerns with him over Manila’s handling of China’s participation in the 13th Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus). “No. That’s not true,” Teodoro said in an interview with ANC when asked whether Asean countries had privately questioned the Philippines’ actions. “If not, they would have told me directly in a letter addressed to me or a […]...
